{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgNQoDvWygcywxwb52JRM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019oQgXg2iFUPFAV5AcjVn2s","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/csvdata/read.go","content":"package csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one data record and the 1-based source line on which it starts.\ntype Record struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tFields []string\n}\n\n// Table is a parsed CSV input: the header record and the data records after it.\ntype Table struct {\n\tHeader  []string\n\tRecords []Record\n}\n\n// Read parses r as RFC 4180 CSV. The first record is the header and every later\n// record is a data record. Values are returned as parsed, untrimmed. Input with\n// no record returns a nil Header and no error; Validate rejects it.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\tcr.LazyQuotes = false\n\n\tvar t Table\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tt.Header = header\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tfields, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tt.Records = append(t.Records, Record{Line: line, Fields: fields})\n\t}\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":901,"cache_read_input_tokens":35688,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":901},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d62bac60-a516-42df-8b83-7a951236f15a","uuid":"155b3c4a-098e-429c-a50c-c592cd25c58f","timestamp":"2026-10-25T05:35:38.060Z","request_id":"req_011CgNQoDeeKiqWs5bbqJDsE","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_019oQgXg2iFUPFAV5AcjVn2s":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/csvdata/read.go","content":"package csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one data record and the 1-based source line on which it starts.\ntype Record struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tFields []string\n}\n\n// Table is a parsed CSV input: the header record and the data records after it.\ntype Table struct {\n\tHeader  []string\n\tRecords []Record\n}\n\n// Read parses r as RFC 4180 CSV. The first record is the header and every later\n// record is a data record. Values are returned as parsed, untrimmed. Input with\n// no record returns a nil Header and no error; Validate rejects it.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\tcr.LazyQuotes = false\n\n\tvar t Table\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tt.Header = header\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tfields, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tt.Records = append(t.Records, Record{Line: line, Fields: fields})\n\t}\n}\n"}}}

The first record is the header and every later\n// record is a data record. Values are returned as parsed, untrimmed. Input with\n// no record returns a nil Header and no error; Validate rejects it.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\tcr.LazyQuotes = false\n\n\tvar t Table\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tt.Header = header\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tfields, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tt.Records = append(t.Records, Record{Line: line, Fields: fields})\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_019oQgXg2iFUPFAV5AcjVn2s","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgNQoDvWygcywxwb52JRM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Y3wrfj6ihRkpUAT8j2rkZQ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/csvdata/validate.go","content":"package csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// ErrRejected matches every input rejection with errors.Is.\nvar ErrRejected = errors.New(\"input rejected\")\n\n// RejectedError describes why an input was rejected. Line is the 1-based source\n// line of the offending record, or 0 when the rejection concerns the header or\n// the whole input.\ntype RejectedError struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tReason string\n}\n\nfunc (e *RejectedError) Error() string {\n\tif e.Line == 0 {\n\t\treturn e.Reason\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"line %d: %s\", e.Line, e.Reason)\n}\n\n// Unwrap makes errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) true for every RejectedError.\nfunc (e *RejectedError) Unwrap() error {\n\treturn ErrRejected\n}\n\n// Validate rejects input that must produce no output: no header record (empty\n// or blank-only input), an empty or repeated header name, and any record whose\n// field count differs from the header. csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc mustRead(t *testing.T, input string) *Table {\n\tt.Helper()\n\ttable, err := Read(strings.NewReader(input))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read(%q): unexpected error: %v\", input, err)\n\t}\n\treturn table\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderAndRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,qty\\nwidget,2\\ngadget,5\\n\")\n\n\tif want := []string{\"name\", \"qty\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n\tgot := make([][]string, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tgot[i] = rec.Fields\n\t}\n\twant := [][]string{{\"widget\", \"2\"}, {\"gadget\", \"5\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record fields = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadQuotedComma(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,note\\n\\\"Smith, J\\\",ok\\n\")\n\n\tif len(table.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(table.Records))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"Smith, J\", \"ok\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadTrailingNewline(t *testing.T) {\n\twithNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\twithoutNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\")\n\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(withNewline, withoutNewline) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"with newline = %+v, without = %+v; want equal\", withNewline, withoutNewline)\n\t}\n\tif len(withNewline.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(withNewline.Records))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadRecordLineNumbers(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The first data record starts on line 2 and spans lines 2-3 through the\n\t// quoted newline; the next record starts on line 4.\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,\\\"multi\\nline\\\"\\n3,4\\n\")\n\n\tlines := make([]int, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tlines[i] = rec.Line\n\t}\n\tif want := []int{2, 4}; !reflect.DeepEqual(lines, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record lines = %v, want %v\", lines, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"a,b\\n\", \"a,b\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want %q\", input, table.Header, := range []string{\"\", \"\\n\\n\\n\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif table.Header != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want nil\", input, table.Header)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record fields = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadQuotedComma(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,note\\n\\\"Smith, withNewline, withoutNewline)\n\t}\n\tif len(withNewline.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(withNewline.Records))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadRecordLineNumbers(t *testing.T) \"a,b\\n1,\\\"multi\\nline\\\"\\n3,4\\n\")\n\n\tlines := make([]int, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tlines[i] = rec.Line\n\t}\n\tif want := []int{2, 4}; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgNQuS2CdaaEX2riQBHNL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Cgf2M1VQxda2EpmTJK5rzy","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/profile/infer_test.go","content":"package profile\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc expectType(t *testing.T, want string, values ...string) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif got := InferType(values); got != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"InferType(%q) = %q, want %q\", values, got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestInferIntegerColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeInteger, \"0\", \"-12\", \"345\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferNumberColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeNumber, \"1\", \"2.5\", \"-0.75\")\n}\n\nfunc TestIntegerPreferredOverNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeInteger, \"10\", \"20\", \"-30\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeInteger, \"10\")\n}\n\nfunc TestNullsIgnoredWhenInferringNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeNumber, \"1\", \"NA\", \"\", \"N/A\", \"null\", \"2.5\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeInteger, \"7\", \"null\", \"NULL\", \"\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMalformedNumericsAreNotNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"+1\", \"1.\", \".5\", \"1e3\", \"1,5\", \"0x10\", \"-\"} {\n\t\tt.Run(value, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\texpectType(t, TypeText, value)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"1\", \"+1\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferDateColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeDate, \"2025-01-31\", \"2024-02-29\", \"1999-12-31\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInvalidCalendarDateIsNotDate(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"2025-02-30\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"2025-13-01\")\n}\n\nfunc TestLeapDayHandling(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeDate, \"2024-02-29\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"2025-02-29\")\n}\n\nfunc TestDateShapeIsStrict(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"2025-2-3\", \"2025/02/03\", \"20250203\", \"2025-02-03T10:00\"} {\n\t\tt.Run(value, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\texpectType(t, TypeText, value)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNullsIgnoredWhenInferringDate(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeDate, \"2025-01-01\", \"NA\", \"\", \"n/a\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferBooleanColumnMixedCase(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeBoolean, \"true\", \"FALSE\", \"False\", \"TRUE\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeBoolean, \"NA\", \"True\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferTextFallback(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"apple\", \"2025-01-01\")\n\texpectType(t, TypeText, \"1\", \"x\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferEmptyWhenAllNull(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeEmpty, \"NA\", \"\", \"null\")\n}\n\nfunc TestInferEmptyWhenNoRows(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectType(t, TypeEmpty)\n\tif got := InferType([]string{}); got != TypeEmpty {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"InferType(empty slice) = %q, want %q\", got, TypeEmpty)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestBooleanLookalikesAreText(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"yes\", \"no\", \"t\", \"f\", \"y\", \"n\", \"on\", \"off\"} {\n\t\tt.Run(value, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\texpectType(t, TypeText, value)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgNQuS2CdaaEX2riQBHNL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019pjW71YKG6KpjHwVNYZD8z","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/cli/args_test.go","content":"package cli\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestParseArgsFileOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := (Options{File: \"data.csv\"}); opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"name\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := (Options{Column: \"name\", ColumnSet: true, File: \"data.csv\"}); opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsFreqTop(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--freq\", \"name\", \"--top\", \"3\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\twant := Options{Freq: \"name\", FreqSet: true, Top: 3, TopSet: true, File: \"data.csv\"}\n\tif opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsEmptyValueIsSet(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !opts.ColumnSet || opts.Column != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want ColumnSet with empty Column\", opts)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsMissingFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"name\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with no file: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsExtraFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"a.csv\", \"b.csv\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with two files: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsUnknownOption(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--frobnicate\", \"data.csv\"}); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn runArgs(t, path)\n}\n\nfunc runArgs(t *testing.T, args ...string) (code int, stdout *bytes.Buffer, stderr *bytes.Buffer) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tstdout, stderr = &bytes.Buffer{}, &bytes.Buffer{}\n\tcode = Run(args, stdout, stderr)\n\treturn code, stdout, stderr\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunHeaderOnlyFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunRejectedInputExitsThreeWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"empty file\":        \"\",\n\t\t\"blank lines only\":  \"\\n\\n\\n\",\n\t\t\"empty header name\": \"id,,name\\n1,x,y\\n\",\n\t\t\"repeated header\":   \"id,name,id\\n1,x,2\\n\",\n\t\t\"ragged record\":     \"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\\n6,7\\n\",\n\t\t\"bare quote\":        \"a,b\\n1\\\"x,2\\n\",\n\t}\n\tfor name, content := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, content)\n\t\t\tif code != exitRejected {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitRejected)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunUsageErrorExitsTwoWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tcases := map[string][]string{\n\t\t\"no arguments\":        {},\n\t\t\"option after file\":   {path, \"--column\", \"a\"},\n\t\t\"unknown option\":      {\"--frobnicate\", path},\n\t}\n\tfor name, args := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, args...)\n\t\t\tif code != exitUsage {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitUsage)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunMissingFileExitsOne(t *testing.T) {\n\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.csv\")\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, missing)\n\tif code != exitOperational {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOperational)\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFormsAreNotUsageErrors(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600);
